claims: C1 rail-free models that can output restricted content are useful for safety testing and red teaming
C2 publicly deployed models should comply with the Model Spec
C3 publicly deploying a model is forbidden when the model is rail-free, can output restricted content, and is susceptible to violating root-level principles through a system message

concepts.name: rail_free
concepts.gloss: M is a model that is 'rail free', meaning it is not constrained by the usual safety rails and can therefore output restricted content

concepts.name: can_output_restricted_content
concepts.gloss: M is a model that can output content the Model Spec treats as restricted

concepts.name: susceptible_to_violating_root_principles_via_system_message
concepts.gloss: M is susceptible to violating root-level principles through a system message, meaning a system message can cause M to act contrary to root-level principles

concepts.name: model
concepts.gloss: M is a model that could be publicly deployed
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of models that we deploy publicly, so the subject of the prohibition is a model

concepts.name: complies_with_model_spec
concepts.gloss: M is a model that complies with the Model Spec

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: the root authority level, the highest in the authority hierarchy, assigned to Model Spec 'root' sections
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the node's NEEDS contract assigns (mechanical licence correction under DECISION_licence_textual.md, 2026-08-16)

concepts.name: system_authority
concepts.gloss: the system authority level, assigned to Model Spec 'system' sections and system messages
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the node's NEEDS contract assigns (mechanical licence correction under DECISION_licence_textual.md, 2026-08-16)

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: the ranking of instruction authority levels: root > system > developer > user > guideline > no authority, used to determine which instruction prevails in conflicts
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the node's NEEDS contract assigns (mechanical licence correction under DECISION_licence_textual.md, 2026-08-16)

asserts.read_back: publicly deploying % is forbidden because % is a rail-free model that can output restricted content and is susceptible to violating root-level principles through a system message

closure.reason: the clause forbids public deployment only for models that are rail-free, can output restricted content, and are susceptible to violating root-level principles via a system message; it does not forbid other public deployments, so silence permits them
